About Us

Infinity Constructions is an ISO-certified Tier 2 builder with
over 30 years’ experience delivering commercial, institutional,
and complex projects for long-term asset owners across NSW
and Victoria.

We are a multi-award-winning Melbourne and Sydney
construction company that is active across all sectors of the
industry.

“We have built our reputation as a quality builder that places
outstanding customer service at the heart of our business. We
are motivated by delivering excellence for our clients.”
